Triage first-touch + claim, by the `domain:devx` PM seat (#6023, session `session_01DdCnBGcHeufjrq7drTD3wt`).

**Disposition: dispatch, with the card's own split respected.** This card is honest that its two halves are not the same kind of thing, and that is why it is dispatchable rather than needing a maintainer:

- `packages/core/src/security/anonymous-deny.ts:7` — the stale comment naming two surfaces that are both gone. **Unambiguous; fix it.** The card says so itself: it "has no such defence".
- The three `handleGraphQL` test doubles — **a real question, not an obvious yes.** A wildcard fall-through test may legitimately want a method the dispatcher does *not* route, precisely to prove it falls through. The dispatch is to **decide it by reading the tests**, not to delete on sight.

Claim: `/pm-dispatch` **domain:devx** execution seat (bug-first, batched round).
Session: `session_01DdCnBGcHeufjrq7drTD3wt`
Branch: `claude/issue-10835-graphql-double-residue`

Domain: `domain:devx`
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus`
File surface: `packages/core/src/security/anonymous-deny.ts` (comment), `packages/adapters/hono/src/__mocks__/runtime.ts`, `packages/adapters/hono/src/hono-wildcard-fallthrough.test.ts`, `packages/adapters/hono/src/hono.test.ts`.

## Serial constraints checked at claim time

**PR #10828** (`claude/issue-10710-graphql-residue-api-index`) is the card this was parked out of. It is `content/docs/**` only — **disjoint from your surface**, verified by its file list, not assumed. **PR #10824** (`perf(security,protocol)`) is open and touches security-adjacent code; check whether it holds `anonymous-deny.ts` before you edit, and report what you found either way.

## Standing constraints

- ⛔ Governed, human-merge-only: `docs/adr/**`, `.claude/**`, `skills/**`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`.
- ⛔ Never edit `content/docs/releases/**`.
- ⛔ Never `git stash` — `refs/stash` is shared by every worktree of the repo.
- ⛔ **Never write `--` when passing args to vitest through pnpm.** pnpm forwards the separator verbatim and vitest's `cac` **silently discards everything after it** — file pattern and `--maxWorkers` both dropped, the whole suite runs, exit 0. Correct: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/adapter-hono test --maxWorkers=2 <file>`. You will be running these two test files directly, so this one is live for you.
- ⚠️ **A pipe swallows the exit code.** Capture as `cmd > log 2>&1; ec=$?`.
- ⚠️ `packages/adapters/hono` and `packages/core` are **published** — a behavioural change needs a changeset; a comment-only change may not. Decide from your real file list.
- ⚠️ Apply labels **additively** (`POST /issues/N/labels`), never a whole-set PUT, and read them back after the size labeler runs.
- ⚠️ GitHub's **secondary** rate limit on content creation is being hit in this repo today (it is not the core quota — that reads ~15k remaining). If a comment POST fails, back off and retry on a timer rather than hammering.

Report back to me; I review against GitHub and land it.
